plain_text.visual: Navy + white. Left: pile of books crossed out. Right: Bookster UI with completed reads. Bold headline overlay.
plain_text.concept: Comparison static. Contrast layout: unread stack vs. Bookster app. Before/After visual.
plain_text.primary: You already know which books matter. Bookster gets you through them — key ideas, 15 minutes, actually retained. Start free.
plain_text.headline: Read smarter, not longer.
plain_text.hypothesis: Rational tone + benefit hook for Achievers at mid-funnel produces higher-quality install than generic efficiency copy.
plain_text.learning_question: Does HK_Benefit outperform HK_Problem for a rational, ambitious avatar? ↘ diagonal ST_MOFU.

plain_text.visual: Aspirational palette — rich navy or forest green, warm gold accent. Clean desk setup or curated bookshelf. Feels premium.
plain_text.concept: Lifestyle outcome static. Identity-upgrade framing. Not "save time" but "become the person who has read the things that matter."
plain_text.primary: The founders, operators, and professionals who stay sharp share one habit: they actually finish the books. Bookster makes that possible. Start free.
plain_text.headline: The reading list of people who stay ahead.
plain_text.hypothesis: Aspirational tone with problem hook creates tension for Achievers — they recognize the problem but feel pulled forward by aspiration.
plain_text.learning_question: Does TN_Aspirational + HK_Problem outperform TN_Rational + HK_Benefit (C1A) for the Achiever avatar?

plain_text.visual: High-contrast. Dark or navy background, white text. App rating visible (4.8★). Bookster logo prominent. CTA implied in layout hierarchy.
plain_text.concept: Comparison static pushed to maximum directness. Bottom-funnel — reader may have already seen Bookster. Short, no-introduction copy.
plain_text.primary: 15 minutes. Core ideas. Retained. Over 1,000 titles. Start your free trial — no card required.
plain_text.headline: Most book apps summarize. Bookster teaches.
plain_text.hypothesis: BOFU assertive comparison for solution-aware Achievers converts the comparison shopper with a direct final push.
plain_text.learning_question: Does ST_BOFU + TN_Assertive produce higher CVR for solution-aware Achievers vs MOFU content?

plain_text.visual: Bold, high-contrast. Dark background. Strong typographic hierarchy. Headline IS the visual. Data element (4M users) as graphic stat.
plain_text.concept: Behavior shift static. Confrontational but not hostile. Names the gap between aspiration and reality directly. ↙ diagonal PR_DataDriven.
plain_text.primary: It's not going to happen the way you've been trying. 4 million people changed their approach. 15 minutes a day. Start free.
plain_text.headline: You said you'd read more this year.
plain_text.hypothesis: Hardest combination: PAS + Assertive + Problem hook for Achievers. Tests whether maximum directness converts or repels the ambitious professional.
plain_text.learning_question: Is assertive PAS too aggressive for Achievers, or does the directness cut through where softer tones cannot? ↙ diagonal test.

plain_text.visual: Editorial palette — warm cream, deep green accent. Non-fiction books or podcast headphones. Overlay text structured, clean.
plain_text.concept: Lifestyle static. Not a product demo — shows the reader you become. Editorial feel.
plain_text.primary: Most content disappears within 24 hours. Bookster turns 15 minutes into ideas you actually keep. Try it free.
plain_text.headline: You consume a lot. You retain less than you think.
plain_text.hypothesis: Rational tone creates cognitive dissonance for a depth-seeking aspirational avatar — logical framing where they expect emotional.
plain_text.learning_question: Can TN_Rational work for an identity-driven avatar, or does it flatten the message?

plain_text.visual: App screenshot dominant. Real Bookster library: philosophy shelf, economics shelf, history shelf — real titles visible. Headline overlaid above.
plain_text.concept: Product demo static. App library screenshot showing real book titles across philosophy, history, economics. The breadth IS the proof.
plain_text.primary: Bookster covers the books that matter — philosophy, history, economics, business, science. Read or listen. Key ideas retained. Try free today.
plain_text.headline: 1,000 books. 15 minutes each. Actually understand them.
plain_text.hypothesis: Rebuilt product demo with rational tone and problem hook converts deeper-learning audiences who need to see the product before committing. ↘ diagonal.
plain_text.learning_question: Does showing the real product (CN_ProductDemo) outperform lifestyle framing (C2A) for Depth Seekers?

plain_text.visual: Editorial. Rich, warm palette. Bookster library titles from philosophy and history — real, recognizable titles. Feels like a high-quality curated library.
plain_text.concept: Comparison static. Not cost comparison — quality comparison. Bookster vs skimming content and retaining nothing.
plain_text.primary: Over 1,000 titles spanning philosophy, history, economics, and science — condensed into 15-minute reads that hold the actual ideas. Start learning free.
plain_text.headline: Finally understand the books that matter.
plain_text.hypothesis: Aspirational tone with data proof — aspiration provides identity pull while data validates content quality. ↙ diagonal PR_DataDriven.
plain_text.learning_question: Can PR_DataDriven be aspirationally framed? Does data feel credible or cold for an identity-driven audience?

plain_text.visual: Aspirational editorial. Warm, rich palette. Books, knowledge, intellectual environment. Person implied — curious, engaged. No guilt, no missed deadlines.
plain_text.concept: Lifestyle static. PAS reframed: the problem is not failure — it's untapped capability. Aspirational agitation.
plain_text.primary: The ideas in the books you haven't gotten to yet are still waiting. Bookster closes that gap. 15 minutes. Try free.
plain_text.headline: You're capable of understanding more than you've read.
plain_text.hypothesis: Most unexpected combination: PAS + Aspirational + Benefit hook. Tests whether intellectual aspiration can be agitated effectively.
plain_text.learning_question: Can FW_PAS be aspirationally toned? Does agitating a desire (rather than a pain) work as persuasion?

plain_text.visual: Clean, minimal. White background. Typography-forward. Stat overlay: "80% of books go unfinished." Deliberately rational visual register.
plain_text.concept: Behavior shift static. Names the behavioral pattern as a logical sequence. Rational register throughout.
plain_text.primary: Most books lose 80% of readers before chapter 3. The format is the problem — not you. Bookster works differently. Try free.
plain_text.headline: You start books. You don't finish them. There's a reason.
plain_text.hypothesis: Rational tone applied to a naturally emotional avatar tests whether logical or empathetic framing is the correct register for C3.
plain_text.learning_question: Does TN_Rational land for Foggy Brain, or does it feel tone-deaf? Key C3 diagnostic.

plain_text.visual: Warm, calm palette — soft cream or warm white. Open book with bookmark stuck in chapter 1. Feels relatable, not clinical.
plain_text.concept: Behavior shift static. Recognition-first creative. Names the experience without naming any condition. PAS + Emotional register.
plain_text.primary: Most people with a stack of unread books aren't lazy — they're stuck with a format that wasn't built for them. 4 million people switched to Bookster. Try it free.
plain_text.headline: You've started that book three times.
plain_text.hypothesis: Core C3 formula. PAS + Emotional + Problem hook. ↙ diagonal tests whether data proof (PR_DataDriven) adds or subtracts from the emotional register.
plain_text.learning_question: Does adding PR_DataDriven to an emotional PAS message lift or dampen conversion for empathy-first audiences?

plain_text.visual: Softest visual in the matrix. Warm cream background. Person reading comfortably — relaxed, enjoying it. Small Bookster UI inset. Natural light.
plain_text.concept: Lifestyle static. Not comparison, not demo — identity of the learner who found their way in. Warm, inviting, no shame. ↘ diagonal ST_MOFU.
plain_text.primary: Short, structured, no 300-page commitment. Bookster works the way your brain does. Try it free — no pressure, no guilt.
plain_text.headline: Reading that actually fits how you think.
plain_text.hypothesis: Lifestyle + benefit hook for Foggy Brain tests whether leading with the positive outcome converts better than the problem frame.
plain_text.learning_question: Does HK_Benefit outperform HK_Problem for C3? Does framing around gain (ease, fit, relief) outperform guilt/friction?

plain_text.visual: Warmest visual in the matrix. Soft, inviting. Person mid-read, relaxed, comfortable. Warm lighting. Headline feels like something a friend would say.
plain_text.concept: Behavior shift static. Full empathy mode. Names the start-and-stall experience. Validates without judgment. Most emotionally resonant cell in the matrix.
plain_text.primary: Reading isn't the problem. Most books just weren't designed for how you actually think. Bookster was. Try it free — no long books, no guilt.
plain_text.headline: You've started that book three times. It's okay.
plain_text.hypothesis: The full empathy formula for Foggy Brain: PAS + Emotional + Problem hook. The highest-potential C3 cell.
plain_text.learning_question: Does the full empathy PAS outperform TN_Rational (C3A) and HK_Benefit (C3C) for the Foggy Brain avatar?

plain_text.visual: Clean white. Two-column: LEFT — physical book with price tag. RIGHT — Bookster app with price. Numbers are the visual hero.
plain_text.concept: Comparison static. Cost-focused. Before: book costs + unfinished reads. After: Bookster value. Bridge: clear cost comparison.
plain_text.primary: You've spent over $200 on books this year. Bookster gives you 1,000+ titles for less than a coffee a month. And you'll actually finish them. Try free.
plain_text.headline: $18 a book. $9 a month for all of them.
plain_text.hypothesis: Confirmed control formula. Replicates Pauli H2 commercial signal in U.S. English static format. ↙ diagonal PR_DataDriven.
plain_text.learning_question: Does this replicate the only confirmed purchase signal in U.S. English? Baseline for all other cells.

plain_text.visual: Same clean white comparison structure as C4A but typography bolder, larger. Primary headline is the visual hero. Less visual complexity.
plain_text.concept: Comparison static. Same comparison frame as C4A but with direct, confident, no-hedging assertive voice. No data required — assertion carries authority.
plain_text.primary: You know which ones they are. Bookster gives you the ideas without the shelf guilt. Less than a coffee a month. Start free.
plain_text.headline: Stop buying books you won't finish.
plain_text.hypothesis: Assertive tone for Growth Woman tests whether a harder register outperforms the warmer rational approach (C4A). Isolates TN_Assertive vs TN_Rational.
plain_text.learning_question: Does TN_Assertive produce better performance than TN_Rational for the same avatar and concept structure?

plain_text.visual: Clean, structured, conversion-optimized. White background. Bookster interface showing book count or category breadth. Headline bold, direct.
plain_text.concept: Comparison static at BOFU pressure. Rational, direct, minimal. The reader already knows they should do this — the ad removes the final objection.
plain_text.primary: 1,000+ titles. 15 minutes each. Less than a coffee a month. Your free trial starts today — no card required.
plain_text.headline: The books you want to read. Actually finished.
plain_text.hypothesis: BOFU push for Growth Woman with rational tone. Tests whether explicit conversion pressure accelerates trial for the highest-confidence ICP.
plain_text.learning_question: Does ST_BOFU improve or hurt performance for C4 vs ST_MOFU (C4A)? FW_BAB row variable at maximum funnel stage.

plain_text.visual: Clean rational comparison. Cost data prominent: "$300/year on books, finishes fewer than 5" as graphic stat. Bookster as smarter alternative.
plain_text.concept: Comparison static. PAS applied to cost waste: money spent on books not finished → the loop won't break → Bookster makes it worth it.
plain_text.primary: The average person spends $300/year on books and finishes fewer than 5. Bookster costs less than two of them — and you'll actually get through the ideas. Try free.
plain_text.headline: You don't need more books. You need to finish the ones you have.
plain_text.hypothesis: PAS framework applied to C4 control ICP. Tests whether PAS outperforms FW_BAB (C4A) for the same commercial avatar. ↘ diagonal critical.
plain_text.learning_question: Does FW_PAS outperform FW_BAB for the Growth Woman? The ↘ diagonal isolates PAS across maximum avatar diversity.

signal_cards.title: C4E is the current checkout-depth control
signal_cards.rationale: C4E's aspirational authority/static system is the checkout-depth control. It generated the clear majority of onb_initiate_checkout volume.
signal_cards.recommended_action: Build challenger variants around the aspirational authority pattern before scaling unrelated concepts.

signal_cards.title: C2B unlocks registration but weakens at checkout depth
signal_cards.rationale: C2B's product-demo/time-saving creative is the registration control, especially among female 45-54, but it failed to carry checkout depth in V3.
signal_cards.confidence: high for registration, directional for checkout
signal_cards.recommended_action: Keep C2B as registration control while routing checkout-depth strategy through C4E/C2F challengers.

signal_cards.title: Facebook Reels shows the strongest checkout CPA signal
signal_cards.rationale: Facebook Reels produced 6 checkout results at $22.35 CPA versus Facebook Feed at 8 results and $52.14 CPA in V3 placement signal.
signal_cards.recommended_action: Prioritize Reels-adapted variants for the C4E authority pattern and C2F value comparison before broadening placement decisions.

signal_cards.title: C2F shows commercial clarity on limited spend
signal_cards.rationale: C2F produced both a trial and checkout on small spend; sample is too small for a scale claim.
signal_cards.recommended_action: Keep C2F in validation queue and avoid claiming winner status until isolated spend increases.
